blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Surgical teams could benefit from assistants that watch the video for requested events, such as "tell me when the clip applier appears during Calot triangle dissection", and answer questions about what has already happened. We formalise this task as request-driven event detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, and present SurgStreamer. It separates procedure-specific perception, which maps the 1-FPS stream to a structured state over tools, actions and phases, from procedure-agnostic reasoning, which evaluates a formal monitoring condition over this state and an event memory, either with exact rules or with a small controller that addresses entities through pointers rather than names. We evaluate this monitoring core with gold conditions. On a pre-registered, sealed test set of 12 laparoscopic cholecystectomies, SurgStreamer reached a macro event-F1 of 0.598 over full procedures. On identical 75-s windows with only the window available to every method, it scored 0.677. The tested configurations of the streaming vision-language model OneStreamer-4B, including ones fine-tuned on SurgStreamer's state or on video with an adapted vision encoder, scored at most 0.540 (Holm-adjusted p <= 0.012). At three external centres, re-training only perception raised performance on held-out procedures from 0.239 to 0.470. On a new procedure, pituitary surgery, controller weights trained on cholecystectomy matched an in-domain controller on oracle state (0.947 vs 0.938). On predicted state they missed the pre-registered non-inferiority margin (-0.024 [-0.040, -0.008]) unless the alert thresholds were re-calibrated. The results support separating perception from reasoning and point to perception under distribution shift as the main limitation.
blocks.zh: 外科团队可以从观看视频的助手们为所请求的事件而受益,比如"在Calot三角解剖期间出现剪接器时告诉我",并回答关于已经发生的事情的问题. 我们把这个任务正式化为由请求驱动的事件检测,包含精确的语义和因果警报决定,并呈现出SurgStreamer. 它将程序特定感知区分开来,将1-FPS流在工具,动作和相位上映射到结构化状态,从程序不可知推理中分离出来,它评价了这个状态上的正式监测条件和事件内存,要么有精确的规则,要么有一个小控制器通过指针而不是取名处理实体. 我们用黄金来评估这个监测核心 SurgStreamer在预先注册的12个膝盖囊肿的封口测试中,通过全程达到了0.598的宏事件-F1。 在只有每种方法可用的窗口的75-s相同的窗口上,它得分为0.677分. 被测试的流线视觉语言模型OneStreamer-4B的配置,包括了在SurgStreamer状态上或视频上经过微调并配有被修改的视觉编码器的配置,得分最多为0.540分(Holm-educted p <=0.012). 在三个外部中心,只进行再培训的观念将暂停程序的业绩从0.239提高到了0.470。 在新的手术中,垂体外科手术,接受过胆囊切除术训练的控制器重与甲骨文状态的域内控制器相匹配(0.947 vs 6.938)。 在预测的状态下,他们错过了预先登记的非贫困差值(-0.024 [-0.040,-0.08]),除非重新调整了警戒阈值。 结果支持将观念与推理区分开来,并指出分配转变中的看法是主要的限制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is among the most frequent abdominal operations. Its most feared complication, bile-duct
injury, is linked to the misidentification of structures before they are clipped and cut. Surgical guidelines
therefore require a critical view of safety before the cystic duct and artery are divided ( Strasberg and Brunt, 2010 ) , and recent work has automated the assessment of this view from video ( Mascagni et al., 2022 ) . Beyond such fixed checks, a surgical team may want to ask an assistant to watch for events
of its choice: “tell me when the cystic duct is being clipped”, “alert me if the clip applier appears during Calot
triangle dissection”, or “has the cystic artery been cut yet?”. Such requests are phrased in natural language but
refer to a predefined vocabulary of instruments, actions and phases, combined by a small set of operators. They are
time-critical: an answer is useful only if it arrives when the event happens, once per occurrence, and never for an
event that did not happen. In this work, events are visible events as defined by the dataset annotations; we do not
assess whether an action was performed correctly, the quality of structure handling, or the prevention of
complications.

blocks.en:
Surgical data science has mainly addressed recognition ( Maier-Hein et al., 2017 ) : phases ( Twinanda et al., 2017 ; Jin et al., 2018 ; Czempiel et al., 2020 ; Garrow et al., 2021 ) , instruments, and actions ( Nwoye et al., 2022 ) . These methods label frames or segments; they do not answer user requests, and their
metrics do not measure when an event is signalled. Streaming vision–language models (VLMs) can be prompted with such
requests ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , and streaming models now narrate surgery as it unfolds ( He et al., 2026 ) . A recent time-aware benchmark found that general and medical VLMs degrade markedly when
they must decide when to answer or alert ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . In the configurations we tested,
streaming VLMs alerted when an
instrument was merely visible rather than appearing, alerted on absent objects, rarely detected disappearances or
phase changes, and needed hundreds of milliseconds of GPU time per request and second of video. Fine-tuning reduced
but did not remove these failures, even when it included the vision encoder. Fig. 1 shows a request on
a sealed test procedure, the decisions SurgStreamer takes on it, and the silence of the two strongest fine-tuned
VLMs.

blocks.en:
We argue that proactive monitoring should be grounded in a structured state, and that the reasoning over this state
should be separated from the procedure. SurgStreamer (Fig. 2 ) maps the video stream to a
probabilistic state over a closed vocabulary of tools, actions and phases. A formal monitoring condition is evaluated
over the state stream and an event memory, and alerts are decided causally. Perception is procedure-specific and must
be trained for each procedure, and possibly for each centre. Reasoning sees entities only through their kind and
state, never through their names, which makes it a candidate for reuse across procedures. A natural-language compiler
maps requests to conditions; it is an interface module, and our evaluation targets the monitoring core given formal
conditions. This paper tests three claims: 1. Event-level monitoring with exact semantics. Request-driven monitoring can be specified as event
detection with exact semantics and causal alert decisions, covering confirmation, once / every / n n -th modes,
composition and retrospective memory. We provide a benchmark of 20 query families with exact references and hard
negatives. 2. Name-free pointer control over structured state. A small learned controller that reads the state
through entity pointers and structured temporal features improves event monitoring over the exact rules on a
pre-registered sealed test. Built on this state, the system outperforms the tested streaming-VLM configurations,
including fine-tuned and vision-adapted ones, under equal context. 3. The transfer boundary. Frozen controller weights transfer to a new procedure on oracle state, while
perception, and on predicted state the alert thresholds, must be adapted. We measure this at three external centres
and on a new procedure, and we report where the claim fails. The perception components (a fine-tuned DINOv3 encoder, causal temporal heads, an ordered phase model) are
established techniques that we use as a strong, documented substrate. Pre-registration and sealed test sets serve to
make the three claims testable.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Online phase recognition progressed from convolutional
features with recurrent models ( Twinanda et al., 2017 ; Jin et al., 2018 ) to temporal convolutions and transformers ( Czempiel et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) ; Garrow et al. (2021) review the
field. Instrument presence is usually learned jointly, and fine-grained actions are modelled as
instrument–verb–target triplets ( Nwoye et al., 2022 ) . Surgical foundation encoders pretrained on large video
collections aim at representations that transfer across tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Multi-centre benchmarks such
as HeiChole ( Wagner et al., 2023 ) and procedure-specific ones such as PitVis ( Das et al., 2025 ) document
performance drops across centres and procedures. We use such recognition models as the perception layer and evaluate
event timing explicitly.

blocks.en:
Online action detection ( De Geest et al., 2016 ) and action
spotting ( Giancola et al., 2018 ) evaluate causal predictions and event timing within a tolerance. Our metric
follows this practice and adds request-specific semantics (modes, phase restrictions, ordering), a confirmation
interval defined from the annotations, and an explicit state for accumulating evidence.

观察(Giancola等,2018年)在容忍度范围内评价因果预测和事件时间. 我们的衡量标准
遵循这种做法并添加特定请求的语义(模块、相位限制、命令),确认
从注释中定义间隔, 以及用于积累证据的清晰状态 。

blocks.en:
Streaming video LLMs decide at every frame whether to
respond ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) ; some add a compressed long-term memory ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We use OneStreamer-4B ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , a streaming fine-tune of Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) with a native proactive protocol. Surgical VLMs address visual question answering and representation
learning ( Seenivasan et al., 2022 ; Seenivasan et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) , mostly on frames or clips and
retrospectively. SurgOnAir ( He et al., 2026 ) brings streaming to surgery: it narrates the procedure frame by
frame and emits sparse state tokens at phase and step transitions, with steps generated by a language model from
narration transcripts. It describes the workflow rather than answering user requests, and it is evaluated by the
pairwise preferences of an LLM judge, not by the timing of the transitions it signals.

blocks.en:
MedStreamBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) evaluates medical video
understanding under explicit evidence windows, across 22 datasets including Cholec80, HeiChole and PitVis. Its
proactive mode asks a model to answer no alert , uncertain or alert as a stream unfolds, and
scores the first alert against the expected time (responsiveness) and whether the model stays positive afterwards
(stability). General and medical VLMs degraded markedly in its streaming and proactive settings. We adopt the same
three-way response space but evaluate it differently: an alert is an edge , one per requested occurrence and
scored at every second against exact event definitions, so repeated alerts count as false alerts; and hard negatives
test whether a model stays silent when nothing new happens.

learned controller that approximates the exact semantics under perception noise. Table 1 summarises the capabilities.

blocks.en:
All VLM baselines use OneStreamer-4B ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) with its native proactive protocol (silence, standby and

and the window drops frames and replies together, so no dialogue history survives beyond 16 s. No additional memory
module was used. Decoding used temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8 and top- k k 20, with one run at seed 42. Our VLM
conclusions are limited to this configuration.

blocks.en:
In the original window protocol, SurgStreamer’s state was computed from the whole procedure, while the VLMs saw the
window. In the equal-context protocol, SurgStreamer is reset at each window start: its temporal heads start
from a zero hidden state, its decoders start cold, its phase model starts from class priors, and its controller
features start at the window. The state-reading baselines then read this reset state. Equal context equalises the available history. How much of it a method can use still differs: SurgStreamer accumulates a state over
the 75 s, while OneStreamer attends to its last 16 updates. A whole-procedure window reproduces the full-history
state exactly.

and C-LLM stays silent. The VLMs behaved differently on negatives. Zero-shot video alerted on all absent-object windows and on 89 % of
persistent-presence windows. C-LLM and V-VA were rarely triggered by persistent presence (FPR 0.02 and 0.07), but they
achieved this partly by staying silent, which lowered their recall. SurgStreamer’s persistent-presence FPR was 0.16. For families answered by the exact rules, such
alerts require an error of the decoded state, such as a visible instrument decoded as absent for at least 3 s or a
spurious phase switch; for families answered by the learned controller, a controller error is also possible.

blocks.en:
Excluding the request compiler, which runs once when a request is issued, SurgStreamer needs about 10 ms and 0.64 GB
of GPU memory per 1-s update (Table 8 ). Most of the time is spent on the frame encoder and temporal
heads, which are shared by all requests. The batched controller took 0.15, 0.16 and 0.18 ms for 1, 10 and 100
concurrent requests. The tested OneStreamer configuration needed 0.34–0.74 s and ≈ \approx 9 GB per update for one
request; additional requests need their own streaming sessions and forward passes, although the model weights could
be shared. For a single request, SurgStreamer is therefore 34–74 times faster and needs 14 times less GPU memory.

blocks.en:
Applied to all 33 HeiChole procedures without retraining, the system scored 0.231 [0.202, 0.258]
(Table 10 ). On HeiChole’s ground-truth state the rules reproduced every reference; this confirms that
the benchmark construction is consistent, but it does not by itself exclude errors of the learned controller or of
the decoders. The diagnostics point to perception and event timing as the main limitation. Frame-level recognition
remained high for grasper, irrigator and specimen bag (average precision 0.96, 0.91 and 0.86) but dropped for clip
applier and scissors (0.40 and 0.25). Grasper episodes fragmented (59 predicted vs 38 true per procedure). In
addition, HeiChole marks an instrument present from the first appearance of its tip, which shifts onsets: grasper
onset F1 was 0.38 at ± \pm 2 s and 0.64 at ± \pm 30 s. Re-training only perception on procedures 1–21, with controllers, thresholds and hybrid choices unchanged, raised
performance on procedures 25–33 from 0.239 to 0.470 (+0.231 [+0.190, +0.277], p ≤ 0.002 p\leq 0.002 ). On this adapted state
the learned controllers were not better than the exact rules.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
The requests that matter are about events: appearances, disappearances,
phase transitions and their composition. SurgStreamer gives them exact semantics over a state stream. Given oracle
state, the exact rules answer every benchmark request correctly by construction, and the learned controller nearly so
(0.947 on PitVis oracle state). On predicted state, the results therefore suggest that perception and event timing are
the main limitation (Sections 5.3 – 5.5 ). The tested VLM configurations detected appearances far better
than disappearances or phase entries. Giving them SurgStreamer’s state as text helped substantially, yet a
4B-parameter model reading that state remained below a 64-unit controller reading it through pointers. We hypothesise
that the difference lies in the representation of time: the controller receives explicit run lengths and times since
events, whereas the VLM must infer them from a 16-update dialogue. Our experiments do not isolate this mechanism. The
equal-context study shows that SurgStreamer’s advantage on Cholec80 does not depend on access to the procedure history.
A further property of the design, which we did not evaluate with users, is that every decision can be traced to the
decoded state and the condition that produced it (Figs. 1 , 6 and 9 ), so
that an error can be attributed to perception or to the reasoning by inspection; an end-to-end VLM does not expose
such an intermediate state.

请求事关事件:出现、失踪、
阶段过渡及其组成。 SurgStreamer在一条州溪上给他们提供了精确的语义. 赐予神谕
准确规则通过构建正确回答每个基准请求 学习控制器几乎如此
(pitvis oracle状态0.947). 因此,在预测状态下,结果表明,感觉和事件时间是
主要限制(第5.3至5.5节)。 测试的 VLM 配置检测到外观要好得多
而不是失踪或阶段性记录。 将SurgStreamer的状态作为文字,
4B参数模型读取状态仍低于64个单元控制器通过指针读取. 我们假设

然而,核查团必须从16个更新的对话中推断这些事件。 我们的实验并不孤立这种机制。 这个

这样的中间状态。

blocks.en:
We distinguish three levels of reuse: the rule semantics, the controller weights and the
controller’s alert thresholds. The rule semantics transfer by construction. On oracle state, the controller weights
trained on cholecystectomy transferred unchanged to a procedure with a different anatomy, camera and vocabulary, and
performed like a controller trained there. On predicted state, unchanged weights and thresholds did not meet the
pre-registered non-inferiority margin, whereas re-calibrating only the thresholds on three validation procedures
reached the in-domain point estimate. Perception did not transfer across centres at the 2-s event level, but
re-training only perception doubled performance without changing the reasoning. The adaptation boundary of the design
therefore held for the rule semantics and the controller weights, while the thresholds belong to the
procedure-specific side.
blocks.zh:
我们区分了三个层次的再利用:规则语义、控制器重量和
控制器的警戒阈值 。 规则语义通过构建来转移. 在甲骨文状态下,控制器的权重
接受过胆囊切除术培训,没有改变,转而采用不同的解剖学、相机和词汇,以及
表现得像个训练有素的管制员 在预测状态下,没有变化的重量和阈值没有达到
预先登记的非优惠差值,而仅重新调整三个审定程序的阈值
达到了域内点估计值。 在2s活动级别上,观念并没有跨中心转移,但
重新训练只是感知性能翻了一番而不改变推理. 设计的适应界限
因此为规则语义和控制器的权重所持有,而阈值属于
程序方面。

blocks.en:
On external data, the diagnostics implicate instrument appearance,
episode fragmentation and annotation conventions. The failure cases (Section 5.5 ) show how such
errors reach the decision: a condition evaluated correctly on a wrong decoded state still produces a wrong alert. On HeiChole, SurgStreamer scored nominally higher with equal context
than with full history (0.363 vs 0.324, n.s.); one possible explanation, which we did not test, is that errors of the
frozen perception accumulate over long streams. The raw-video V-LoRA, built on a general-purpose visual encoder, was
nominally better on HeiChole, which suggests that surgical fine-tuning may trade robustness for in-domain accuracy.

事件分散和注释公约。 失败案例(第5.5节)表明,

名义上在"黑洞"(HeiChole)上更好,这表明外科微调可能会以稳健性换取域内精度.

blocks.en:
The reasoning was trained on one procedure, and transfer was tested on one new procedure and
one external dataset with small test sets (7 and 9 procedures). Event timing is bounded by annotation conventions,
and rare actions and unseen entity compositions remain hard; which part of the controller (recurrence or slot
features) produces its gain was not isolated. The VLM conclusions hold for the tested OneStreamer-4B configurations,
each run once with sampling. Requests were generated from templates over a closed vocabulary, the main results use
gold conditions, and in-vocabulary objects that are simply not visible were not tested. No surgeon wrote requests
or rated alerts, and no prospective evaluation was performed, so clinical utility remains to be shown.

blocks.en:
Natural next steps are free-text requests written by surgeons, a failure attribution across
compiler, perception, decoding and control, and a sensitivity analysis of the episode parameters G G and K K .
Wider baselines are also needed, including other streaming models, a state-of-the-art recognition model combined with
C-rule, and a retrospective baseline for the event memory. Because SurgStreamer shares its response space, it can be
evaluated directly on the proactive items of MedStreamBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) drawn from the procedures
studied here, which we have not done. Multi-procedure surgical pretraining and label-free
adaptation of perception are promising ways to reduce the annotation needed per centre.

编译器,感知,解码和控制,以及对插曲参数G和K K的敏感性分析.
还需要更广泛的基线,包括其他流线模型、最先进的识别模型和
C规则和事件记忆的追溯基线. 因为SurgStreamer分享了它的响应空间,它可以是
根据程序直接评估MedStream Bench(王等,2026年)的积极项目
在这里学习,我们没有这样做。 多程序手术前培训和无标签
适应观念是减少每个中心所需注释的有希望的方法。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
SurgStreamer answers natural-language monitoring requests over surgical video streams by evaluating compiled conditions
over a structured state, with learned or exact reasoning and an event memory. On a pre-registered sealed test with
gold conditions, it outperformed the tested OneStreamer-4B configurations under equal context, including fine-tuned
and vision-adapted ones, at a fraction of their cost. Its controller weights transferred unchanged to a new procedure
on oracle state; on predicted state, they matched an in-domain controller only after re-calibrating the alert
thresholds. Its perception had to be re-trained for new centres and procedures. These results support state-grounded,
modular designs for proactive surgical monitoring and point to perception under distribution shift as the main
remaining obstacle.
blocks.zh:
SurgStreamer通过评价编译的条件,回答外科视频流的自然语言监测请求
在一个结构化的状态, 具有学到的或准确的推理和事件记忆。 在预先登记的密封测试中
黄金条件,它比测试过的 OneStreamer-4B 配置在等上下文下,包括微调
和能适应视力的, 成本的一小部分。 其控制器加权数未改变地转入新程序
在甲骨文状态下; 在预测状态下, 它们只在重新校正警报后匹配域内控制器
阈值。 必须对它的认识进行重新培训,以适应新的中心和程序。 这些结果支持基于国家,
主动进行外科手术监测的模块设计,并将分布变化中的感觉作为主要
其余障碍。

blocks.en:
The pre-registered decisions favoured simplicity. The backbone fine-tuned on
cholecystectomy transferred better than generic DINOv3, also to pituitary surgery (0.29 vs 0.19 at k = 5 k=5 on the
development pools), and the frozen learned controller exceeded the exact rules at every k k on both targets. Neither
candidate add-on met its adoption rule. Calibrating the adapter lowered false alerts by 35–40 % but did not raise
macro event-F1, and a controller trained on simulated perception errors lost 0.035 on Cholec80 and did not improve
transfer.

宏事件- F1, 以及一个接受模拟感知错误培训的控制器在Cholec80上损失了0.035, 没有改进

blocks.en:
The frame encoder was trained with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) : backbone learning rate 2 ⋅ 10 − 5 2\cdot 10^{-5} , heads 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 0.05, 200 warm-up steps and linear decay. It used batches of 32 frames sampled every second
second, random 85–100 % crops, horizontal flips and brightness / contrast jitter, for 6000 steps, with w max = 20 w_{\max}=20 for tools and 50 for actions.

第二,随机85-100%的作物、水平翻转和亮度/对比快感,为6000个步骤,工具为20 w_{\max 20,动作为50。

The temporal heads used 1024-s chunks with batches of 8 (256-s chunks with batches of 16 for the short-context
ensemble), dropout 0.2 and AdamW with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} . Positive weights were clipped at 50 for presence and phase entry, and
at 200 for tool and action onset / offset events. Validation ran every 300 steps, with patience 6 and at most 6000 steps.
